hook.en: Two roads meet at a circle. If we know only their slopes, can we find the angle at which they cross?
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ರಸ್ತೆಗಳು ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವುಗಳ ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ತಿಳಿದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಅವು ಸಂಧಿಸುವ ಕೋನವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದೇ?

objectives.en: Find an unknown slope from a given angle

narration.en: Two roads meet at a circle. If we know only their slopes, can we find the angle at which they cross?
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ರಸ್ತೆಗಳು ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವುಗಳ ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ತಿಳಿದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಅವು ಸಂಧಿಸುವ ಕೋನವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದೇ?

body.en: If lines $L_1$ and $L_2$ have slopes $m_1$ and $m_2$ with $1 + m_1 m_2 \neq 0$, the acute angle $\theta$ between them satisfies $\tan\theta = \left|\frac{m_2 - m_1}{1 + m_1 m_2}\right|$. The obtuse angle is $180^\circ - \theta$. If $1 + m_1 m_2 = 0$, the lines are perpendicular.
body.kn: m₁, m₂ ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳ ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಲಘುಕೋನ θ ಗೆ tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)|. ವಿಶಾಲಕೋನ 180° − θ.

narration.en: The acute angle between two lines comes from tan theta equals the modulus of m two minus m one, over one plus m one m two.
narration.kn: m₁, m₂ ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳ ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಲಘುಕೋನ θ ಗೆ tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)|. ವಿಶಾಲಕೋನ 180° − θ.

narration.en: Two lines make angles theta 1 and theta 2 with the x-axis. The angle between them is the difference, theta 2 minus theta 1.

say.en: Two lines make angles theta 1 and theta 2 with the x-axis. The angle between them is the difference, theta 2 minus theta 1.
Take tan of both sides and use the tan of a difference. Since tan theta 1 is m 1 and tan theta 2 is m 2, we get the formula; the modulus gives the acute angle.
For slopes 1 and root 3, tan theta is 2 minus root 3, so the angle is 15 degrees: 60 minus 45.
Two crossing lines make two angles, theta and 180 minus theta. If 1 plus m 1 m 2 is zero the lines are perpendicular.

caption.en: Set the slopes of two lines through the origin and read the acute angle between them.

narration.en: Set the slopes of two lines through the origin and read the acute angle between them. Make m₁ = m₂: the angle is 0 — the lines are parallel (here, the same).

Try m₁ = 2, m₂ = −0.5: m₁m₂ = −1 and θ = 90°.
Find m₂ that makes 45° with m₁ = 1/2 (two answers).

points.en: tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)| gives the acute angle.
points.kn: tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)| ಲಘುಕೋನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Removing the modulus gives two cases, so two possible slopes.
points.kn: ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಎರಡು ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳು, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಎರಡು ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳು.

homework.en: Find the angle between the x-axis and the line joining (3, −1) and (4, −2).

narration.en: Recap. tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)| gives the acute angle. The obtuse angle is 180° − θ. Removing the modulus gives two cases, so two possible slopes.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)| ಲಘುಕೋನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಶಾಲಕೋನ 180° − θ. ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಎರಡು ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳು, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಎರಡು ಇಳಿಜಾರುಗಳು.
